display.purpose: Page-defining hero headline. One per page.

headline.purpose: Section headings. text-4xl is the workhorse.

body.purpose: Paragraph text at text-white/60, held to 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked group label. Marks a group, never a decorative kicker.

shadows.name: menu
shadows.purpose: Header dropdowns and popovers only, where a panel genuinely floats over content.

shadows.name: action
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA buttons, giving the one interactive element slight physical presence.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover and focus state changes on controls. 35 uses.

motion.name: surface
motion.purpose: Larger surface transitions: menus, panels, CTA fills. 39 uses.

motion.name: ease-default
motion.purpose: Tailwind default easing; the system rarely overrides it.

motion.name: drawer
motion.purpose: Mobile navigation sheet slide-in and slide-out.

rootScale.purpose: html font-size. Every rem-based token inherits a ~6% reduction from browser default.

fontFeatures.purpose: Inter alternate glyphs: single-storey a, straighter digits, cleaner l.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-intent action on a section. Black text on Signal Green is deliberate; white would fail contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #02F8A2; color: #000000; padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4FFAB8; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #00E191; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #050506, 0 0 0 4px rgba(16,185,129,0.5); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The secondary action beside a primary CTA. Stroke only; fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #FFFFFF; padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.20); border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.40); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #050506, 0 0 0 4px rgba(16,185,129,0.5); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat container in the page flow. Tonal step plus hairline, never a shadow.
components.html:
Multi-turn simulation

Full conversations, not single prompts, measured across personas and markets.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #0A0A0C; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 16px; padding: 2rem; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.20); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #FFFFFF; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.65; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.60); margin: 0; }

components.name: Group Label
components.description: Marks a group of content with a signal dot. Not a decorative kicker above a section heading.
components.css: .ds-group-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-group-dot { width: 0.375rem; height: 0.375rem; border-radius: 2px; background: #02F8A2; } .ds-group-label span:last-child { font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.50); }

components.name: Hairline Seam
components.description: The system's signature structural element: a 1px rule fading to transparent at both ends, separating stacked sections.
components.css: .ds-hairline { height: 1px; width: 100%; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.10), transparent); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Header link. Muted at rest, resolving to full white on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.60); text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #050506, 0 0 0 4px rgba(16,185,129,0.5); border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Genezio measures something invisible — what machines say about a brand when nobody is watching. The interface is built like the readout of a precision instrument: a near-black chassis, hairline rules that organize without decorating, and a single luminous green that means signal. Nothing glows unless it carries a reading.

The density is editorial rather than dashboard-like. Sections breathe at a fixed rhythm, the container holds at max-w-7xl with px-6 md:px-8 lg:px-16 gutters, and type is set on a slightly reduced 15px root so the whole surface reads calmer and denser than a default Tailwind build. The result should feel like something an enterprise buyer would trust with a board slide: exact, unhurried, quietly expensive.

Depth comes almost entirely from tonal layering — three near-black steps that a casual eye reads as one — not from shadows. Sixty-six shadow utilities across twenty-two thousand lines is the measure of this restraint.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black chassis with a single emerald signal color
Hairline borders at 10% white as the primary structural device
Flat by default; depth via three tonal steps, not elevation
15px root size — the whole system scales ~6% down from browser default
Inter Variable with alternate glyphs enabled (cv02 cv03 cv04 cv11 ss01)

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Emerald means "a reading, a result, or the next action." It is never used to make a section look designed. If an element is emerald and carries no data and no action, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Three-Step Rule
rules.body: There are exactly three background values: Void #050506 for the page, Band #0E0E10 to stripe sections apart, Surface #0A0A0C for cards. A fourth tone is not a new token; it is drift. Anything nested deeper than a card uses a translucent white overlay (bg-white/5), not another opaque hex.

rules.name: The No-Gray Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is text-white/60, never text-zinc-400 or a gray hex. Opacity keeps text harmonized with whatever sits behind it. This rule is aspirational, not descriptive: text-zinc-400 still appears 173 times against 275 for text-white/60, a second vocabulary inherited from an earlier pass. New work uses the opacity ladder; existing zinc values are a known migration, not a precedent.

rules.name: The Semibold Default Rule
rules.body: Headings are font-semibold, not font-bold. Bold is reserved for emphasis inside a heading or for numerals in data. Reaching for bold on every heading flattens the hierarchy the weight step is supposed to create.

rules.name: The Balanced Heading Rule
rules.body: h1-h4 carry text-wrap: balance and letter-spacing: -0.02em globally. Never leave a one-word orphan on a heading's last line; if balance does not fix it, rewrite the heading.

rules.name: The Label Is Not An Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The uppercase tracked label marks a group — a SWOT quadrant, a nav column, a table header. It is never a decorative kicker floating above a section heading to announce the section. The heading carries its own weight.

rules.name: The Invariant Gutter Rule
rules.body: px-6 md:px-8 lg:px-16 on every section wrapper. Left edges must align down the entire page — a section that indents differently breaks the instrument-panel read more than any color mistake.

rules.name: The Earned Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this element is above the page plane" — a menu, a dialog, a button you press. A card sitting in a grid is not above the page; it gets #0E0E10 and a hairline instead.

rules.name: The No Halo Rule
rules.body: Shadows carry offset and blur. A zero-offset colored glow around an emerald element is decoration, and this system does not use it.

dos: Do use px-6 md:px-8 lg:px-16 on every section wrapper so left edges align down the page.
Do express secondary text as text-white/60 and let opacity do the tinting.
Do keep the accent at or under 10% of a screen's area. Its rarity is what makes it mean something.
Do reach for a hairline border (border-white/10) before reaching for a shadow.
Do set section rhythm with py-24 md:py-32.
Do use font-semibold for headings and reserve font-bold for genuine emphasis.
Do let the global :focus-visible ring handle keyboard focus.
donts: Don't introduce a fourth background tone. Void, Band, Surface — anything deeper is a translucent white overlay.
Don't use gray text values (text-zinc-400, text-gray-500) — they desynchronize from the surface behind them.
Don't apply gradients to text. Emphasis comes from weight, size, or the accent color.
Don't place a decorative uppercase kicker above a section heading. The tracked label marks a group, not a section announcement.
Don't add focus:outline-none without an explicit replacement ring.
Don't put a shadow on a card that sits in the page flow.
Don't compensate for the 15px root by bumping every Tailwind size up a step.
